doc.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021

title: Sun Ra reading people; the child drummer
summary: Sun Ra could read a person like a book and wanted spirit rather than knowledge; he had a child play drums to show a professional drummer what he meant.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Okay. I think sometimes we try to make things too complicated. But I’m wondering how he dealt with such a — I mean I’ve been in my share of bands and eventually there’s always personality conflicts, people grate on each other’s nerves and so forth. Did he try to fix those things or did he just let them play out?

He was what they call a natural, a natural. He was the kind of person that he could look at you and look at your potentials and your faults and everything. He could read you like a book. And you couldn’t get away with anything, with the slick stuff. He would expose you, you know? So he’s saying that’s what you know and you’re going in that direction and I’m not going in that direction, I’m going in the direction of what you feel and the spirit of things, which is real. So if you — most people come in with “I know this, I know that.” I knew how to play but I didn’t know how to take that playing I’m doing and make it real, the spirit you know? So when he said I don’t want to hear what you know, I want to hear what you don’t know. Or I want you to do what you’re not doing.
And did that result in some of the techniques that you now use on the alto?

Yeah, because I had to try everything I could think of, good, bad or what I think is good, what I think — you know, but until I could get the spirit, the soul of playing something, you see? So for example, a professional drummer was in and Sun Ra was playing a tune. So he wanted, he told the drummer, so the drummer would know he knew there was a wealth of professional drummers. He was playing I mean playing everything he knew. So Sun Ra said no, you don’t understand what I mean. So they went outside and there were some children out there. So he said, “Come here little boy,” and little boy come in. And he said, “Now here’s some sticks, this is the drum, now play — when I play you play with me.” So the little boy didn’t know anything and he did perfect. Perfect drum so, drum with Sun Ra playing his music. So he told the professional, “You see what I mean? He doesn’t know anything and he’s going to do by feeling and spirit.” And he did the
right thing, that’s the way the spirit works. You see? It’s showing that because you know that’s not relevant. You know?
